Our Philosophy

Grounded in Kerala Heritage

Vilstay was founded to offer travellers an authentic connection to Kerala’s diverse landscapes — without the detachment of conventional hotels.

Authentic Kerala,

preserves traditional laterite masonry and regional cuisine.

Our Origin

Every Stay Has a Character

We believe true luxury in travel is found in serenity, thoughtful design, and a genuine sense of place. From hand-chiseled laterite courtyard estates in Malappuram to private hilltop plantations in Wayanad, each property in our collection is independently managed and carefully curated.

Our hosts are residents of the region who understand the local seasonal rhythms, regional delicacies, and scenic backroads. When you stay with Vilstay, you are a welcomed guest, not a room number.

Quality Assured

The Four Commitments

Architectural Integrity

Properties featuring traditional Kerala carpentry, laterite stone, or scenic topography with authentic regional presence.

Dedicated Hosting

Attentive on-site caretakers and staff committed to personalized service, privacy, and genuine regional cuisine.

Verified Amenities

Cleanliness standards, air conditioning, modern plumbing, and reliable Wi-Fi confirmed by regular inspections.

Direct Relationship

Transparent seasonal tariffs with direct concierge support and no third-party booking commissions.
